notes: Capacity_mw uses the reported expandable/planned capacity; existing reported capacity is 6 MW.

project_name: Former Star Tribune North Loop printing plant data center
status_detail: Business Journal and local news report Legacy Investing agreed to buy the shuttered Star Tribune printing plant in Minneapolis' North Loop for redevelopment into a 20 MW data center; sale expected to close in Q4 2026 pending conditions including city CUP approval.
notes: Minneapolis enacted a temporary large-data-center moratorium in 2026, but reports say downtown projects under 350,000 sf may be exempt; project still depends on local approvals.
